title: Automated medical microscope under NDA
summary: Development and deployment of an automated microscope for analysing medical samples during the COVID-19 crisis, while details concerning the samples and the precise medical use remain confidential.

sections.title: Context
paragraphs: This technical consulting assignment was carried out for Vidya Health Ltd during the COVID-19 crisis.
The type of sample analysed and the precise medical purpose of the device are covered by a confidentiality agreement.

sections.title: Design and development
paragraphs: The assignment focused on microscope automation and development of the software required for its operation.
items: Development of the control software using LabVIEW.
Integration of the software into the prototype.

sections.title: Deployment and knowledge transfer
paragraphs: The prototype was deployed in its operating environment.
items: Production of technical and user documentation.
Subsequent replication of the prototype on two additional microscopes.

sections.title: Result
paragraphs: The automated microscope was deployed, and the solution was subsequently replicated on two additional instruments.
